与自然一起成长(Growing up with nature): 一篇关于自然环境的B1记叙文:本的经历、感受与成长。

What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. On Friday evenings, Ben reviews the notes from class. People around Ben often share different ideas about the camping site. In fact, crossing the frozen river alone was a foolhardy decision.

Ben has practiced football for three years and won a prize last term. At first, Ben found it difficult to keep the habit. Ben believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Also, dried mealworms tempt shy thrushes.

Sam always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Ben wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Ben will take part in a football match in June. Tessa sings in the school choir every Tuesday.
The camping site looked quieter than usual that evening. Ben prefers snowy weather when running in the gym. Little by little, things began to change. Insect mesh excludes carrot fly.
Ben thanked Sam for the honest advice. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. There are always more possibilities than we expect.
